### Checklist

The check gate below mirrors CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) — green locally
means green in CI. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for details.

- [ ] `cargo fmt --check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo test` passes (unit + integration)
- [ ] `cargo audit` passes
- [ ] `./tests/run.sh` passes (bash installer/registry tests)
- [ ] Commit subjects follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`release-plz` depends on this)
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, DCO)
